CREATE POLICY finance_managers_insert_pending_payroll ON hr.payroll FOR INSERT TO PUBLIC WITH CHECK ( current_setting('app.employee_id', true) IS NOT NULL AND current_setting('app.job_role', true) = 'finance_manager' AND current_setting('app.tenant_id', true) IS NOT NULL AND tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::integer AND approval_status = 'pending' AND EXISTS ( WITH RECURSIVE dept_hierarchy AS ( SELECT d.department_id FROM hr.departments d WHERE d.department_id = (SELECT department_id FROM hr.employees e WHERE e.employee_id = current_setting('app.employee_id', true)::integer AND e.tenant_id = tenant_id) UNION ALL SELECT d2.department_id FROM hr.departments d2 JOIN dept_hierarchy dh ON d2.parent_department_id = dh.department_id WHERE d2.tenant_id = tenant_id ) SELECT 1 FROM hr.employees emp WHERE emp.employee_id = hr.payroll.employee_id AND emp.tenant_id = tenant_id AND emp.department_id IN (SELECT department_id FROM dept_hierarchy) ) AND department_id = ( SELECT department_id FROM hr.employees e WHERE e.employee_id = hr.payroll.employee_id AND e.tenant_id = tenant_id ) );
